content.value: Open the stats panel from the inventory to see calculated character values. It includes passive, equipment, enchantment, status-effect, requirement-penalty, and conditional contributions that are active at that moment.

Flat values add units, such as +40 armour, +8 fire damage, or +20 maximum health.
Increased values are percentages added to the relevant multiplier, such as 15% increased fire damage.
Extra damage creates another damage component from a source amount; it is not the same as conversion.
Conversion moves a share of physical damage into another element.
Penetration reduces the target's effective defence for the matching hit; it is not a permanent debuff.

A local rune changes the item it is printed on. Local increased physical damage scales that weapon's base damage plus its flat physical rune damage. Local armour, evasion, and [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]] percentages scale that armour piece's matching base plus flat rune value. Quality is applied to the base before flat runes and local percentages.

A global stat is granted to the wearer or wielder and modifies the character total or combat calculation. Resistances, maximum health, global critical chance, elemental damage, leech, regeneration, and ailment stats are common global examples.
The wording matters. 'Increased Armour' on an armour-piece local rune changes that one base. A global armour modifier from the passive tree scales the entity's overall armour attribute.
